verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.141
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.141

verses.pali: 14. Yodhājīvavagga
verses.english: 14. A Warrior

verses.pali: Assaparassasutta
verses.english: Excellent Horses

verses.pali: “Tayo ca, bhikkhave, assaparasse desessāmi tayo ca purisaparasse.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you the three excellent horses and the three excellent people.

verses.pali: Taṁ suṇātha, sādhukaṁ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: Listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo assaparassā?
verses.english: “What are the three excellent horses?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assaparasso javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: One excellent horse is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assaparasso javasampanno hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: Another excellent horse is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco assaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: While another excellent horse is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo assaparassā.
verses.english: These are the three excellent horses.

verses.pali: Katame ca, bhikkhave, tayo purisaparassā?
verses.english: “What are the three excellent people?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco purisaparasso javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: One excellent person is fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca; na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: Another excellent person is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: While another excellent person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno hoti; na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
verses.english: And how is an excellent person fast, but not beautiful or well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṁ orambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant, with the ending of the five lower fetters, is reborn spontaneously. They’re extinguished there, and are not liable to return from that world.

verses.pali: Idamassa javasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho saṁsādeti, no vissajjeti.
verses.english: But when asked a question about the teaching or training, they falter without answering.

verses.pali: Idamassa na vaṇṇasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re not beautiful, I say.

verses.pali: Na kho pana lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: And they don’t receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Idamassa na ārohapariṇāhasmiṁ vadāmi. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno hoti;
verses.english: This is how they’re not well proportioned, I say. This is how an excellent person is fast,

verses.pali: na vaṇṇasampanno, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: but not beautiful or well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno?
verses.english: And how is an excellent person fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṁ orambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant, with the ending of the five lower fetters, is reborn spontaneously. They’re extinguished there, and are not liable to return from that world.

verses.pali: Idamassa javasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.

verses.pali: Idamassa vaṇṇasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re beautiful, I say.

verses.pali: Na kho pana lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: But they don’t receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Idamassa na ārohapariṇāhasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re not well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti; vaṇṇasampanno ca, na ārohapariṇāhasampanno.
verses.english: This is how an excellent person is fast and beautiful, but not well proportioned.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca?
verses.english: And how is an excellent person fast, beautiful, and well proportioned?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pañcannaṁ orambhāgiyānaṁ saṁyojanānaṁ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant, with the ending of the five lower fetters, is reborn spontaneously. They’re extinguished there, and are not liable to return from that world.

verses.pali: Idamassa javasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re fast, I say.

verses.pali: Abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṁ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṁsādeti.
verses.english: When asked a question about the teaching or training, they answer without faltering.

verses.pali: Idamassa vaṇṇasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re beautiful, I say.

verses.pali: Lābhī kho pana hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṁ.
verses.english: They receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Idamassa ārohapariṇāhasmiṁ vadāmi.
verses.english: This is how they’re well proportioned, I say.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, purisaparasso javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
verses.english: This is how an excellent person is fast, beautiful, and well proportioned.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo purisaparassā”ti.
verses.english: These are the three excellent people.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
